verdict.rationale: Dover documents its own Chrome extension, the Dover Sourcing Extension, which sources a candidate from their LinkedIn profile into a job and lets the recruiter email them without leaving the page. That covers the core LinkedIn-to-ATS capture. Nothing in the evidence shows capture from the wider web or any deduplication of candidates already in the ATS. missing for 10: capture from non-LinkedIn web pages, deduplication against existing candidates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, a browser extension captures prospects from LinkedIn and the web straight into the ATS with deduplication

citations.quote: The Dover Sourcing Extension is a Chrome extension that lets you source a candidate from their LinkedIn profile into one of your jobs and email them without leaving the page.
